description: This file declares the interface for a factory class that creates IPC (Inter-Process Communication) instances related to media pipeline capabilities within the Rialto client namespace. It includes licensing information, include guards, and a class with static and virtual methods for creating factory and media pipeline capability objects.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating IPC media pipeline capabilities objects, providing static and virtual methods for object creation.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Static method to create and return a shared pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create and return a unique pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilities object for IPC.
